theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 31 群

items.colloc: fastened securely 牢固地繫上 | stored securely 安全地存放
items.distinct: safely 安全地（指無危險）| firmly 堅固地（指結構）
ex: Please ensure the files are stored securely.
請確保檔案被安全地存放。
The heavy boxes were fastened securely.
沈重的箱子已被牢固地繫好。
Data must be backed up securely online.
資料必須安全地備份在線上。

items.colloc: billed separately 分開計費 | packed separately 分開包裝
items.distinct: individually 個別地（強調個人）| apart 分離（空間距離）
ex: Please pack the fragile items separately.
請將易碎品分開包裝。
These two services are billed separately.
這兩項服務是分開計費的。
The departments work quite separately now.
各部門現在是分開運作的。

items.colloc: severely damaged 嚴重受損 | severely criticized 嚴厲批評
items.distinct: strictly 嚴格地（強調規定）| harshly 嚴苛地（強調態度）
ex: The building was severely damaged by fire.
這棟建築因火災嚴重受損。
Budget cuts have severely affected operations.
預算刪減已嚴重影響運作。
Management was severely criticized by staff.
管理層受到了員工嚴厲的批評。

items.pos: v. 分享；分擔 | n. 股份；份額
items.colloc: market share 市場佔有率 | share information 分享資訊
items.distinct: portion 一部分（量）| stock 股票（總稱）
ex: We need to share the workload equally.
我們需要平均分擔工作量。
Our company increased its market share.
本公司提升了市場佔有率。
Please share your feedback with us.
請與我們分享您的回饋。

items.colloc: increased significantly 顯著增加 | significantly lower 顯著較低
items.distinct: largely 大體上 | dramatically 戲劇性地
ex: Our profits increased significantly this year.
我們今年的利潤顯著成長。
The new policy significantly changed procedures.
新政策顯著改變了作業流程。
This design is significantly more efficient.
這個設計顯著地更有效率。

items.colloc: executive summary 執行摘要 | provide a summary 提供摘要
items.distinct: abstract 摘要（學術論文）| outline 大綱
ex: Please read the executive summary first.
請先閱讀執行摘要。
The report ends with a brief summary.
這份報告以簡短的總結結尾。
Can you provide a summary of meetings?
你可以提供會議摘要嗎？

items.pos: v. 供應；提供 | n. 供給；庫存
items.colloc: office supplies 辦公用品 | supply chain 供應鏈
items.distinct: provide 提供（抽象或具體）| offer 給予（主動提供）
ex: They supply parts to many factories.
他們為許多工廠供應零件。
We are running low on office supplies.
我們的辦公用品快用完了。
The supply chain was delayed recently.
供應鏈近期出現了延誤。

items.colloc: long-term 長期的 | payment terms 付款條件
items.distinct: jargon 行話 | condition 條件（情況）
ex: I am not familiar with this technical term.
我不熟悉這個技術術語。
The contract has a three-year term.
這份合約有三年的期限。
Please review the payment terms carefully.
請仔細審閱付款條件。

items.colloc: senior management 高階管理層 | management team 管理團隊
items.distinct: administration 行政（部門）| leadership 領導力
ex: The management team is meeting today.
管理團隊今天正在開會。
Effective time management is essential here.
有效率的時間管理在這裡很重要。
Senior management approved the new budget.
高階管理層批准了新預算。

items.colloc: arrange a meeting 安排會議 | arrange travel 安排差旅
items.distinct: organize 組織（系統化）| plan 規劃（構思）
ex: I will arrange a meeting for tomorrow.
我會為明天安排一場會議。
She helped arrange the travel details.
她協助安排差旅細節。
Please arrange these files by date.
請按日期整理這些檔案。

items.colloc: negatively affect 負面影響 | affect performance 影響表現
items.distinct: effect 效果（名詞）| influence 影響（深遠影響）
ex: The new tax will affect our sales.
新稅制將會影響我們的銷售。
Poor weather may affect the delivery.
惡劣天氣可能會影響配送。
Your positive attitude affects the team.
你積極的態度會影響團隊。

items.colloc: appear to be 似乎是 | appear on the list 出現在名單上
items.distinct: seem 似乎（心理感受）| emerge 浮現（明顯出現）
ex: The error does not appear on screen.
錯誤訊息沒有出現在螢幕上。
He appears to be very busy today.
他今天看起來非常忙碌。
New opportunities appear in the market.
市場上出現了新的商機。

items.colloc: appoint a manager 任命經理 | newly appointed 新任命的
items.distinct: assign 指派（工作）| elect 選舉（投票）
ex: The board will appoint a new CEO.
董事會將任命一位新執行長。
She was appointed as the project head.
她被任命為專案負責人。
They appointed him to lead the team.
他們任命他來領導團隊。

items.pos: v. 購買；買入 | n. 購買
items.colloc: buy in bulk 大量購買 | buy shares 買入股份
items.distinct: purchase 購買（正式）| acquire 收購
ex: We need to buy new office furniture.
我們需要購買新的辦公家具。
It is cheaper to buy in bulk.
大量購買會比較便宜。
Many investors buy shares during dips.
許多投資人在低點買入股份。

items.colloc: sign a cheque 簽支票 | cash a cheque 兌現支票
items.distinct: cash 現金 | draft 匯票
ex: Please write the cheque to the company.
請將支票抬頭寫給本公司。
I need to deposit this cheque today.
我今天需要存入這張支票。
He paid the outstanding balance by cheque.
他用支票支付了未結餘額。

items.pos: n. 成本；費用 | v. 花費
items.colloc: cut costs 削減成本 | high cost 高成本
items.distinct: price 價格（標價）| expense 開銷
ex: We must find ways to cut costs.
我們必須想辦法削減成本。
The total cost includes shipping fees.
總費用包含了運費。
This project will cost a lot.
這個專案將花費很多。

items.pos: n. 緊急狀況；突發事件
items.colloc: emergency exit 緊急出口 | emergency meeting 緊急會議
items.distinct: crisis 危機（嚴重情勢）| urgency 緊急性
ex: We called an emergency meeting today.
我們今天召開了緊急會議。
Please locate the nearest emergency exit.
請找出最近的緊急出口。
The system failed during an emergency.
系統在緊急狀況下故障了。

items.colloc: take an exam 參加考試 | pass an exam 通過考試
items.distinct: test 測試（一般）| certification 認證
ex: She is preparing for the final exam.
她正在準備期末考試。
I need to take a proficiency exam.
我需要參加一場能力測驗。
Many staff members passed the exam.
許多員工都通過了考試。

items.colloc: include tax 包含稅費 | include details 包含細節
items.distinct: contain 含有（容器內）| involve 涉及
ex: The price does not include service fees.
這個價格不包含服務費。
The report should include all sales data.
這份報告應包含所有銷售資料。
Please include your contact info below.
請在下方包含您的聯絡資訊。

items.colloc: mountain range 山脈 | mountain resort 山區度假村
items.distinct: hill 小山 | peak 山峰
ex: We held our retreat at a mountain resort.
我們在山區度假村舉辦了靜修。
The hotel overlooks a beautiful mountain.
這家飯店可以眺望美麗的山景。
They hiked up the mountain this morning.
他們今天早上健行上山。
